subject: Brasswick: one thing before our next meeting
body:
Hi Celia,

Thanks for sharing the Brasswick data room. Could you send the item below by Friday 30 October? We would like it before our partner meeting. A rough version is fine, and if something does not exist yet, just say so.

1. Please send your hiring plan for the next 12 to 18 months.
   Ideally it includes one row per hire with role, start date, base pay and equity.

Thanks,

items.text: Please send your hiring plan for the next 12 to 18 months.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Hiring plan and future org. Also needed for: Payroll rebuilt from the hiring plan, burn and runway recomputed and compared with the deck; Contractors counted in headcount and burn.
items.title: Hiring plan

guidance.title: Hiring plan
guidance.what: A list of the people you plan to add, one row per hire.
guidance.form: A CSV or a spreadsheet tab with one row per planned hire: role, department, start date, base pay and equity grant.
good: pay and start date for every hire

items.includes: one row per hire with role, start date, base pay and equity
